cur:manuscripts-stuttgart-psalter-psalm-.summary: Christ, with a cross-nimbus and holding a book, sits in a green mandorla between two angels, while tongues of flame burst up on either side and consume a fallen enemy at the lower left. The psalm proclaims 'The Lord reigneth … a fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about'.
facts: The Stuttgart Psalter was made around 820–830 at the abbey of Saint-Germain-des-Prés near Paris; its 168 leaves contain the psalms with 316 coloured miniatures set between the verses they illustrate.
Its pictures interpret the psalms literally, historically or — very often — Christologically, as prophecies of the life of Christ.
